jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-3981)  

Axle
is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Benefits We Offer:

100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees
Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
401K match up to 5%
Educational Benefits for Career Growth
Employee Referral Bonus
Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA)
Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK)
Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP)
Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Axle is seeking a proactive Project Manager to support Education and Capacity Building initiatives on an NIH-funded program. You will own projects from planning through delivery, help teams turn complex ideas into practical plans, and coordinate education and technology-related work. We welcome strong generalist Project Managers who are eager to learn the education domain. Success in this role calls for initiative, thoughtful problem-solving, reliable follow-through, and collaborative communication.
What You Will Do Lead assigned projects end to end, managing schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and status reporting.

Coordinate the development and delivery of educational programs, resources, learning platforms, and related operational activities.

Partner with instructional designers and technical teams to support course and content development, coordinate requirements, testing, releases, and implementation, and facilitate the successful adoption of educational resources and technologies.

Build strong cross-functional relationships, facilitate communication, and drive decisions and action items to completion.

Identify and track risks and issues; resolve challenges independently when appropriate or bring leadership a clear assessment and recommended approach.

Identify opportunities to use AI in project and business workflows, and determine when a chatbot, custom GPT, Claude Skill, or other reusable AI workflow is appropriate; configure or help develop these tools and assess their outputs for accuracy and usefulness.

Take initiative in ambiguous situations, producing thoughtful first drafts, plans, and recommendations for review.

Improve workflows, documentation, tracking, and project visibility while incorporating feedback and growing in the role.

What You Bring Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

3+ years of relevant project management experience, including ownership of project plans, timelines, deliverables, and coordination across teams.

Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and follow-through, with the ability to independently advance work and meet commitments.

Strong written and verbal communication, organizational skills, attention to detail, and adaptability.

Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI platforms, including OpenAI and Anthropic; ability to design, test, and refine effective prompts and apply appropriate human review and verification to AI-generated outputs.

Ability to navigate ambiguity, develop thoughtful recommendations and work products, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Experience collaborating effectively with technical and nontechnical teams and managing competing priorities.

Ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies, platforms, and systems.

Experience using Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or comparable project management and collaboration tools.

Preferred Experience PMP, CAPM, Agile, Scrum, or comparable project management certification.

Experience supporting NIH-funded programs, federal contracts, biomedical research, or scientific initiatives.

Experience collaborating with software development or technical teams, including familiarity with the software development lifecycle.

Experience supporting education, training, instructional design, or capacity-building programs.

Experience with learning management systems, educational technology, or other technology-enabled learning platforms.

Teaching, training facilitation, or instructional experience.

Experience implementing new systems, improving workflows, or supporting technology adoption.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Position Overview

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in providing world class support to our external clients and internal teams by managing the end-to-end implementation of contracted technical programs and ensuring they are delivered in a timely manner. No challenge will be too big, and no issue will go unsolved! You are responsible for tracking the status of all programs / projects as assigned by working with different stakeholders, managing customer expectations, providing status reports to management, active risk and issue management, and drive risks/issues/actions to closure. You will create and manage project plans, communicate schedules with different stakeholders and ensure successful delivery of all projects and tickets. You will work in a highly collaborative environment with a team that is geographically distributed. You will adhere to agile software development processes accepted by the organization. The candidate should have excellent analytical and interpersonal abilities and always looking to improve process and bring in efficiencies. Performs other duties as required.

Essential Responsibilities

Responsible for project management of assigned client implementations.
Partner with a cross-functional project team to deliver programs on time, on budget and according to contractual requirements.
Develop, distribute, and manage consolidated project plans, status reports, dashboards and communicate with stakeholders.
Actively manage risks, issues, actions, and dependencies through closure and communicate to maintain alignment.
Partner with the Account Management team to manage customer expectations through concise and timely communication.
Compile, track, and report on project financials throughout project lifecycle.
Works well in a team and is flexible in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to effectively manage time and shifting priorities for self and delivery team.

Qualifications

Minimum 2-5 years of project management experience in a fast-paced environment
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) preferred, relevant industry experience and/or client implementation experience can be substituted
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Computer Engineering or Management Information Systems Degree required
Experience in coaching, leading and influencing others
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Experience in managing projects and schedules using Microsoft Project
Must understand the agile development methodology, applicable roles, and processes
Experienced with Office products like Excel, PowerPoint to generate reports and dashboards
Experienced with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence
Strong problem-resolution, analytical skills, and stakeholder management expertise
Flexible and adaptable about learning, task assignments, and learning new technologies
Some experience with Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tools like Planview, Mavenlink, etc.
Agile Scrum Software Development practices and tools preferred.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You’ll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support

Verra Mobility Values

Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
Lead with Grace. We express humility and compassion, and we are authentic and candid. Our employees demonstrate self-awareness, care for others, instill trust, and communicate effectively.

jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Location:
Surrey, BC, Canada

Reports To:
Director Global Accounts Executive

Salary Range:
CAD $114,000-$156,000

Position Summary

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic Commercial Program Manager
to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The Commercial Program Manager
is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Non-Discrimination Statement

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

Privacy

Information collected and processed as part of your IEM Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to IEM's Workforce Member Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Transformation Program Manager
jobs.description:
Our client, the global leader in technology-enabled claims and risk management solutions,
is actively looking for a Transformation Program Manager
for an AI-enabled software delivery transformation focused on applying AI to software delivery practices. This role is 100% remote but candidates must be able to work CST!

***This is a 12 month contract with the opportunity to extend based on performance and business needs***

This initiative will use a phased pilot-team approach
to evaluate how AI can improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and create measurable cost savings. This Program Manager will work with business, technology, engineering, offshore teams, vendors, internal AI leadership, and senior stakeholders to shape and execute the AI-enabled delivery model.
This role requires a hands-on program leader who can operate in ambiguity, create structure where the path is still being defined, drive decisions, remove obstacles, and keep the initiative moving toward measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

Lead planning and delivery for the AI-enabled software delivery transformation, including workstreams where the process, operating model, or implementation path is still evolving.

Drive day-to-day execution across pilot teams, stakeholders, vendors, and offshore engineering partners.

Work with leadership to select the most suitable projects and pilot teams for applying the AI-enabled delivery model.

Build and manage the integrated project plan, including training, pilot execution, testing, adoption, measurement, and reporting.
Clarify ownership, frame options and tradeoffs, drive decisions, and escalate issues when needed.
Track milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and action items through resolution.
Help turn the AI-enabled delivery approach into practical guidance, documentation, and repeatable ways of working.
Provide clear status updates, risks, issues, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Support benefit tracking for productivity improvements, cost savings, resource usage, and AI-related consumption costs.

Required Qualifications

8+ years as a Technical Project Manager leading software development, IT transformation, or enterprise technology initiatives.

5+ years managing SDLC-based projects, including planning, development, testing, implementation, and adoption.

5+ years leading cross-functional enterprise delivery across business, technical, vendor, and offshore teams.

3+ years supporting transformation initiatives, pilot programs, phased rollouts, or process implementations.

Proven ability to lead ambiguous or first-time initiatives where requirements, processes, stakeholders, or implementation approaches are still evolving.
Strong project planning, coordination, risk management, and executive-level reporting skills.
Ability to translate strategic goals into actionable plans and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in AI, automation, developer productivity tools, or AI-enabled software delivery.

Familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, Agile, or technology operating model transformation.
Demonstrated success measuring productivity gains, cost savings, resource efficiency, or business benefits tied to technology initiatives.
Exposure to portfolio management, project financials, budget planning, or vendor strategy.
Large enterprise IT environment experience.
Strong experience with Smartsheet and other PM tools.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Program Manager based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity leader to oversee security governance, compliance, audit readiness, and continuous monitoring across complex public sector cloud environments in Canada and the United States. You will coordinate critical programs supporting Government of Canada Protected B services, FedRAMP Moderate, and DoD IL4 environments hosted on AWS GovCloud. Working across cybersecurity, engineering, cloud operations, legal, product, and business teams, you will turn regulatory and authorization commitments into clear operational plans and measurable outcomes. You will drive assessment readiness, vulnerability remediation, evidence management, and risk reporting while maintaining strong accountability across control owners. This role offers the opportunity to shape and strengthen a global cybersecurity program in highly regulated environments. You will also serve as a trusted point of coordination for executives, customers, external assessors, and government stakeholders.

Accountabilities

Own and manage the integrated cybersecurity program plan, including governance routines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and executive reporting for Protected B, FedRAMP Moderate, and DoD IL4 initiatives.
Serve as a senior program liaison across cybersecurity, quality and risk management, cloud operations, engineering, product, legal, sales, customer success, external assessors, government sponsors, and authorizing organizations.
Establish and maintain clear RACI assignments, control-owner responsibilities, backup coverage, decision logs, risk acceptance records, and escalation processes.
Translate regulatory, authorization, contractual, and customer requirements into actionable plans, assigned responsibilities, and measurable operational outcomes.
Lead cybersecurity program management for existing Protected B services and coordinate the development, readiness, and operationalization of new Protected B solutions.
Coordinate alignment with Government of Canada security expectations, including ITSG-33 risk management practices, applicable cloud security controls, assessment and authorization activities, and continuous monitoring.
Support Canadian security responsibilities through government and customer communications, evidence coordination, control ownership, personnel and access requirements, security documentation, and assessment activities.
Coordinate data-handling, access, data residency, subcontractor, incident management, and shared-responsibility requirements for Protected B services.
Coordinate FedRAMP Moderate authorization maintenance, annual assessments, control implementation reviews, evidence collection, assessor interviews, continuous monitoring deliverables, POA&M updates, significant-change activities, and customer assurance requests.
Maintain oversight of FedRAMP authorization documentation, including the authorization boundary, System Security Plan (SSP), control implementation statements, policies, procedures, inventories, diagrams, customer responsibility documentation, and supporting evidence.
Ensure findings, risks, and compliance obligations have accountable owners, are tracked through resolution, and are escalated when authorization commitments are at risk.
Lead program coordination for the DoD IL4 GovCloud environment, including DISA and mission-owner engagements, authorization maintenance, eMASS package coordination, annual third-party assessment organization (3PAO) assessments, continuous monitoring, and customer onboarding readiness.
Coordinate responses to DISA requests, corrective action plans, authorization conditions or restrictions, follow-up questions, evidence requests, and remediation commitments, maintaining complete records of decisions, submissions, approvals, and deadlines.
Oversee vulnerability governance across operating systems, containers, repositories, base images, applications, and infrastructure. Maintain assigned owners, remediation plans, recurring dashboards, POA&M traceability, deviation and risk acceptance workflows, and supporting evidence.
Ensure vulnerability reporting clearly communicates out-of-SLA issues, external or customer-facing exposure, authentication and authorization impacts, remediation progress, and residual risk.
Coordinate GovCloud audit readiness, including control-owner assignments, SSP and IL4 addendum reviews, evidence handling, interview preparation, system demonstrations, CUI-aware screen sharing, assessor follow-ups, and final evidence submissions.
Maintain integrated risk registers, corrective action trackers, audit plans, control-owner matrices, compliance dashboards, and executive reports.
Establish governance forums with clear decisions, accountable owners, deadlines, and escalation criteria across security, cloud operations, engineering, and business teams.
Drive root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions for missed assessments, delayed remediation, evidence gaps, unclear ownership, reduced operational capacity, and communication issues.
Deliver concise, fact-based communications to executives, customers, assessors, and government representatives while protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Protected B information, security-sensitive data, and authorization documentation.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least 7 years of experience in cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, auditing, cloud security, or public sector program management, including leadership of complex cross-functional programs.
Demonstrated experience supporting a cloud service provider or SaaS organization operating in regulated public sector environments.
Working knowledge of FedRAMP Moderate, NIST SP 800-53/53A, System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Plans (SAPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), continuous monitoring, annual assessments, and 3PAO engagements.
Familiarity with U.S. Department of Defense cloud authorization concepts, IL4, DISA authorization processes, eMASS, Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), CUI handling, and authorizing official or mission-owner engagements.
Experience managing vulnerability remediation programs, SLA monitoring, exception and deviation requests, risk acceptance, corrective action plans, evidence validation, and executive escalation.
Knowledge of Government of Canada Protected B security expectations, ITSG-33, cloud security controls, shared-responsibility models, and security assessment and authorization practices.
Experience coordinating external audits, control-owner interviews, system demonstrations, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and government inquiries.
Strong program management, organizational, and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage complex activities across multiple teams and regulatory environments.
Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to present risk, compliance, and remediation status to executive, customer, assessor, and government audiences.
Ability to meet the personnel screening, residency, citizenship, background-check, and access eligibility requirements applicable to assigned Canadian and U.S. public sector environments and contracts.
Must be a Canadian citizen and physically located in Canada.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain the Government of Canada security screening required for the role, including at minimum Reliability Status, through Public Services and Procurement Canada’s Contract Security Program (PSPC CSP).
Must be eligible for appointment as the organization's Company Security Officer (CSO) and maintain the security screening required for its organizational security clearance.
Must be able to satisfy additional Government of Canada personnel security requirements applicable to federal contracts, including eligibility for Secret security clearance where contractually required.
Hands-on experience supporting both Government of Canada Protected B and U.S. federal or Department of Defense cloud programs.
Experience working directly with Government of Canada departments, DISA, federal agency authorizing officials, mission owners, 3PAOs, or independent security assessors.
Experience with AWS GovCloud, vulnerability scanning, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), ticketing systems, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) platforms, and evidence management tools.
Relevant professional certifications such as PMP, PgMP, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, CGEIT, or equivalent credentials.

Benefits

Base salary range of CAD 111,500–178,400 for a full-time position.
Potential annual bonuses and short-term or program-specific awards, depending on the role.
Comprehensive benefits package; specific coverage details are not listed in the source.
Flexible remote work arrangement within Canada.
Compensation based on relevant factors such as education, training, professional experience, certifications, location, business needs, and market conditions.
An environment that emphasizes equitable pay, market-based compensation, and skills-based evaluation.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

About Joseph J. Henderson & Son, Inc.

Joseph J. Henderson & Son, Inc. (JJH) is a family-owned general contractor based in Gurnee, Illinois, building since 1928. We specialize in large, complex water and wastewater treatment projects for municipal, federal/military and private owners. We also have an extensive resume with architectural, educational, healthcare, and industrial projects throughout the Chicagoland area.
We self-perform concrete, carpentry, excavation and mechanical process piping, and we deliver projects through general contracting, construction management and design-build.

Location:
Home Office - Gurnee, IL (Project Managers work from the jobsites located throughout northern Illinois and the surrounding region)

Position type:
Full-time, salaried

The Role

We are hiring an experienced Project Manager to lead water and wastewater treatment projects from contract award through closeout. You will own each project's schedule, budget, quality and client relationship, working closely with our superintendents, field crews, estimators and project engineers.

We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance. 
This role is within the Partner Excellence team
, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end partner experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both partner-facing and agent-facing journeys. 
The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global partner excellence programmes with a focus on complex system support in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on: (i)  process optimization and PX improvements across the post‑booking partner journey, (ii) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, (iii) collaboration with product and commercial teams to drive structural changes and (iv) reduce partner effort and CEG cost‑to‑serve, unlock commercial value from partner support insights

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning commercial enablement and process excellence initiatives.
Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: partner satisfaction (e.g., PSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement. 
Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.  
Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.  
Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics. 

  Drive Commercial driven Solutions & Insights in Operations

Partner with Product Management / Technology /CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement. 
Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving complex systems support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points. 
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer, partner and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, post-booking APIs). 

  Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Partner Excellence team.
Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes. 

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

At least 8–10+ years of experience in project/program management, strategy & operations, commercial excellence, process improvement, management consulting, or similar fields.
Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
 Proven track record of leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact. 
 Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

  Technical & Analytical Skills

Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions. 
Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus(you have to be willing to learn) 
Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or PX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

Commercial Excellence, Process, and Delivery Skills

Demonstrated experience in process improvement and transformation, ideally in commercial, operations or customer support environments. 
Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, structure complex problems, and orchestrate cross‑functional teams.
Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost‑to‑serve.

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic, multicultural environment, comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation in a high‑velocity setting.
 A growth mindset and positive attitude: proactive, hands‑on, detail‑oriented, and with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Professional experience with Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with collaboration and project tracking tools is a plus.

Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.

at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. This position will manage Substation projects across the IPSEC model. Includes scoping, estimating, project budgeting and approval, oversight of project execution and project close out.

As a Major Construction Senior Project Manager
, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?

Responsibilities

Manages one or more large, long-term and/or complex projects or programs with responsibility for results in terms of scope, schedule, cost/budget, and risk in accordance with the organization and company policies, procedures and guidelines.

Engages regularly with executive and senior management as a key consultant on critical business issues; Regularly develops and presents to executive and senior management on project related issues and prescribed milestones for approval.
Provides overall project leadership for safety, ensuring that the design incorporates the latest standard and requirements and that the work associated with the project is conducted injury free.
Holds a high level of fiscal responsibility and approval authority related to projects and programs; responsible for leading the development of cost estimates, project and program budgets, approving expenditures and reviewing project expenditures for appropriateness (supports SOX financial accountability).
Initiates project, forms and develops project team, leads the project development, including development of preferred and alternative project scope, leads the environmental assessment development inclusive of state and federal license applications, represents SCE with state and federal agencies, leads project execution including engineering, permit acquisition, land acquisition, construction planning including material procurement, project execution strategy development, contract development and execution, contract management and contractor oversight, testing plans, quality assurance program and plans, and project closeout.
A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.

Minimum Qualifications

Ten or more years of experience in construction project management. Experience structuring, negotiating and managing contracts.
Experience working with environmental agencies in permitting infrastructure projects.
Possess a valid Class C Driver's License.

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Certification and/or PMP
Demonstrated knowledge and experience with Substations through Engineering, Project Management, Construction, Maintence, or Operations
Demonstrated experience translating complex project information into clear, concise presentations and recommendations for senior leadership
Experience specifying and managing project cost/budget, scope, schedule, and resources, managing vendors, and overseeing formal project planning, tracking, and reporting
Experience in project cost, schedule management, project risk analysis and management
Experience with schedule development and management, and experience using Primavera scheduling software
Experience leading direct interactions with regulatory agencies such as the local cities/counties, and state/federal organizations

This position’s work mode is hybrid. The employee will report to an SCE facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days.  Unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of California.  Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
About the position:

We are seeking a mid-level operational Cyber Security Analyst to join our team at Snowy. This hands-on "doer" role will lead the vulnerability management capability and work on assurance and risk management activities.

You will be responsible for protecting the organisation's information systems, networks, and data by monitoring, identifying, analysing, and responding to security vulnerabilities, while supporting the ongoing improvement of cybersecurity controls across our IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments.

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Vulnerability Management (70% Focus):
Lead and execute the full vulnerability management lifecycle, encompassing discovery, risk assessment, prioritisation, and remediation across technology teams and the business. Lead the deployment and implementation of vulnerability management technologies and practices in our OT environment.
Compliance & Risk Assessments:
Support ongoing internal and external security audits, ensuring alignment and compliance against key industry frameworks and standards, such as the Australian Energy Sector Cyber Security Framework (AESCSF), Security of Critical Infrastructure Act (SoCI Act) and ISO 27001.
Project Security Alignment:
Collaborate with project teams to establish clear cybersecurity requirements, ensuring all projects deliver in accordance with established security controls and standards.
Cyber Security Assurance:
Conduct security assessments and assurance activities across systems, applications, and third-party vendors, identify control gaps, and provide recommendations to strengthen the organisation's overall security posture.
Risk Assessments:
Conduct security risk assessments across systems, processes, and third parties; identify, evaluate, and document risks; and work with stakeholders to define appropriate treatment plans and residual risk acceptance.

About the location:

This role can be based in Sydney or Melbourne.

About you:

Functional Leadership & Autonomy:
High degree of self-sufficiency, self-management, and ability to think on your feet. Proven ability to independently lead and drive the vulnerability management function to its next iteration with minimal supervision.
Technical Experience & Capability:
Strong hands-on background across vulnerability management lifecycle tools, as well as technical toolsets in two or more cybersecurity domains (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, EDR, SIEM, PAM, SASE/Netskope, Firewalls, IDAM). A background transitioning from systems engineering or systems administration is highly regarded.
Communication & Stakeholder Management:
Excellent communication skills to work effectively across all levels of the organisation, build constructive relationships with business teams to drive remediations, and present technical concepts clearly.
Framework Familiarity (Favourable):
Knowledge or experience with industry cybersecurity frameworks and legislation—such as the AESCSF, SoCI Act, ISO 27001, NIST and IEC 62443—is considered a favourable addition.
Discretion & Safety Focus:
Ability to act with absolute discretion when handling sensitive company information, coupled with a commitment to demonstrate and drive the highest level of focus on workplace safety.

About our workforce:

Snowy Hydro has a culture of decency and inclusion, with a commitment to the health and wellbeing of our people and a supportive environment to ensure that everyone - regardless of background - feels included and can succeed. At Snowy Hydro, we recognise that we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each individual brings, and we believe in providing an environment that allows that uniqueness to thrive.

Snowy Hydro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for a role with Snowy Hydro and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Snowy Hydro recruitment team at recruitment@snowyhydro.com.au

Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một Trưởng phòng Vận hành có năng lực điều phối vận hành hệ thống và thúc đẩy hiệu quả mạng lưới điểm bán trên toàn quốc. Vị trí này chịu trách nhiệm đảm bảo các hoạt động kinh doanh được triển khai đồng bộ, thông suốt và hiệu quả, đồng thời kịp thời xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh ảnh hưởng đến hoạt động của hệ thống.

I. MÔ TẢ VỊ TRÍ & TRÁCH NHIỆM THỰC THI CHÍNH

Vị trí này chịu trách nhiệm quản lý và tối ưu hoạt động vận hành kinh doanh của công ty, đảm bảo hệ thống điểm bán hoạt động hiệu quả, tuân thủ các chính sách đã ban hành, đồng thời phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh và nâng cao hiệu suất kinh doanh trên toàn hệ thống.

1. Giám sát hoạt động kinh doanh và mạng lưới điểm bán
Theo dõi sức khỏe vận hành của hệ thống:
Theo dõi và phân tích các chỉ số vận hành, kinh doanh hằng ngày thông qua dashboard quản trị, bao gồm tỷ lệ điểm bán hoạt động, số lượng giao dịch, giao dịch PENDING, các cảnh báo bất thường và các chỉ số hiệu suất quan trọng khác.
Quản lý hiệu quả mạng lưới:
Nhận diện các điểm bán hoạt động kém hiệu quả, có dấu hiệu rủi ro hoặc không tuân thủ quy định; chủ động đề xuất các giải pháp hỗ trợ, cải thiện hoặc xử lý phù hợp.
Đảm bảo tính liên tục của hoạt động kinh doanh:
Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để xử lý nhanh các vấn đề ảnh hưởng đến hoạt động của điểm bán và khách hàng, hạn chế tối đa gián đoạn dịch vụ.

2. Quản lý và xử lý các trường hợp ngoại lệ
Tiếp nhận và phân loại sự cố:
Đánh giá các trường hợp ngoại lệ phát sinh trong hoạt động kinh doanh và điều phối xử lý đến đúng đơn vị phụ trách (Công nghệ, Kế toán, Kinh doanh hoặc các bộ phận liên quan).
Ra quyết định vận hành:
Đề xuất hoặc thực hiện các biện pháp kiểm soát phù hợp theo thẩm quyền nhằm giảm thiểu rủi ro cho công ty và mạng lưới điểm bán.
Theo dõi kết quả xử lý:
Đảm bảo các vấn đề phát sinh được xử lý triệt để, đúng thời hạn và có biện pháp phòng ngừa tái diễn.

3. Điều phối hoạt động giữa các bộ phận
Phối hợp với Khối Kinh doanh:
Rà soát định kỳ hiệu quả hoạt động của mạng lưới, xác định các điểm bán cần kiểm tra, hỗ trợ hoặc chấn chỉnh nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả kinh doanh.
Phối hợp với Khối Công nghệ:
Đánh giá tác động của các thay đổi hệ thống, tính năng mới hoặc các sự cố kỹ thuật đối với hoạt động kinh doanh; đề xuất các phương án vận hành phù hợp.
Phối hợp với các bộ phận hỗ trợ:
Tham gia xây dựng và triển khai các quy trình vận hành cho sản phẩm, dịch vụ hoặc chương trình kinh doanh mới.

4. Báo cáo và cải tiến hoạt động
Báo cáo Ban Giám đốc:
Tổng hợp và phân tích báo cáo vận hành kinh doanh định kỳ, bao gồm tình hình hoạt động của mạng lưới, các vấn đề phát sinh, tỷ lệ điểm bán hoạt động hiệu quả và các đề xuất cải thiện.
Đề xuất cải tiến:
Chủ động nhận diện các điểm nghẽn trong vận hành và đề xuất giải pháp nhằm nâng cao năng suất, chất lượng dịch vụ và hiệu quả khai thác mạng lưới.
Chịu trách nhiệm đầu cuối:
Chịu trách nhiệm chính đối với hiệu quả hoạt động của bộ phận Vận hành Kinh doanh và các KPI được giao.

II. YÊU CẦU ỨNG VIÊN

1. Về Kỹ năng & Kinh nghiệm
Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Quản trị Kinh doanh, Kinh tế, Tài chính hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có tối thiểu 10 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực vận hành kinh doanh, quản lý mạng lưới, quản lý điểm bán hoặc các vị trí tương đương.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm tại các công ty fintech, ngân hàng, viễn thông, bán lẻ hoặc doanh nghiệp có hệ thống POS và mạng lưới điểm bán trên diện rộng.
Có khả năng đọc hiểu dashboard, phân tích dữ liệu hoạt động và đưa ra quyết định dựa trên số liệu.
Có kinh nghiệm xử lý các vấn đề vận hành phát sinh và điều phối công việc giữa nhiều bộ phận.
Có kinh nghiệm quản lý đội ngũ là một lợi thế.
Thành thạo Google Sheets và các công cụ quản lý dữ liệu, báo cáo.
Sẽ là một điểm cộng lớn nếu biết sử dụng AI thuần thục nhưng không để AI làm thay mọi việc cho mình, đặc biệt là việc ra quyết định. 

2. Về Phẩm chất cá nhân
Tư duy kinh doanh và định hướng kết quả.
Khả năng ra quyết định nhanh, chính xác dựa trên dữ liệu và thực tế vận hành.
Chủ động, linh hoạt trong môi trường tăng trưởng nhanh và chưa có đầy đủ quy trình chuẩn hóa.
Có khả năng xử lý vấn đề độc lập và chịu trách nhiệm đến cùng với kết quả công việc.
Kỹ năng phối hợp liên phòng ban và quản lý công việc hiệu quả.
Tinh thần trách nhiệm cao, sẵn sàng thích nghi với sự thay đổi.

jobs.description:
该职位来源于猎聘 Department: R&D – AI Strategy & Enablement

Location: Shanghai, China

Position Type: Full-time

Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and proactive Data Analyst & AI Data Governance Specialist to support the development of a data-driven and AI-enabled R&D organization.

The role will focus on improving data availability, quality, structure, governance, and usability to enable effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence across R&D.

The successful candidate will work closely with R&D engineering teams, AI specialists, IT, data owners, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, structure, and prepare data for AI-driven applications, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.

The position combines hands-on data analysis with data governance, data management, and AI data readiness activities.

The ultimate objective is to establish trusted, accessible, secure, and AI-ready data foundations that support scalable AI solutions across R&D.

Key Responsibilities
Data Governance & Management

Support the development and implementation of data governance principles, policies, standards, and processes across R&D.

Establish and maintain data classification frameworks based on sensitivity, confidentiality, business value, and AI usage requirements.

Identify data owners and data stewards and support the definition of clear data ownership and accountability.

Develop and maintain data inventories, catalogs, metadata, and data documentation.

Support data access management, usage policies, lifecycle management, retention, and traceability.

Collaborate with IT, cybersecurity, and compliance teams to ensure data handling aligns with organizational policies and applicable regulations.

Support the establishment of common data definitions, formats, and standards across different R&D functions.

Data Quality & AI Readiness

Assess the quality, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and accessibility of R&D datasets.

Identify and address data gaps, duplication, inconsistencies, and structural limitations.

Define data quality metrics and monitoring processes.

Evaluate datasets for suitability in AI and Machine Learning applications.

Support data preparation, cleaning, transformation, labeling, and validation activities.

Collaborate with AI developers and engineers to establish data requirements for AI use cases.

Improve the reliability and traceability of data used in AI-generated insights and decision-making.

Data Analysis & Insights

Collect, process, analyze, and visualize data from multiple R&D sources.

Develop reports, dashboards, and performance indicators to support data-driven decisions.

Identify trends, anomalies, operational inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns and potential AI opportunities.

Translate business and engineering needs into analytical requirements.

Communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

AI Data Enablement & Use Case Support

Work closely with the AI Strategy & Enablement team to identify data requirements for AI initiatives.

Assess data availability, accessibility, quality, and risks for proposed AI use cases.

Support the preparation of structured and unstructured data for AI models, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.

Collaborate with AI engineers to improve data pipelines and integration requirements.

Identify opportunities to reuse existing datasets across multiple AI applications.

Support the development of scalable and reusable data assets for AI solutions.

Contribute to AI use case prioritization by evaluating data feasibility and readiness.

Data Architecture & Integration Support

Collaborate with data architects and IT teams to define data structures, integration requirements, and data flows.

Support the mapping of data sources, dependencies, and transformations.

Identify opportunities for improving data accessibility and interoperability between systems.

Contribute to data platform and AI ecosystem architecture discussions.

Support the development of standardized datasets and reusable data products.

Document data lineage and dependencies to improve transparency and traceability.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Act as a bridge between R&D engineering teams, AI teams, IT, and data stakeholders.

Promote data literacy, data quality awareness, and responsible data usage.

Support workshops and knowledge-sharing activities related to data governance and AI readiness.

Identify and propose improvements to data management practices.

Track data-related challenges and coordinate actions with relevant stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.

Professional Experience

Experience in data analysis, data management, data engineering, or data governance.

Practical experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.

Experience in data cleaning, transformation, validation, and reporting.

Familiarity with data quality principles, metadata management, and data classification.

Experience collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.

Technical Skills

Strong SQL skills for data extraction, analysis, and transformation.

Proficiency in Python, particularly Pandas and other data analysis libraries.

Experience with Power BI or equivalent data visualization tools.

Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.

Familiarity with relational databases, APIs, and data integration.

Basic understanding of data lakes, data warehouses, and modern data platforms.

Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata management concepts.

Basic understanding of AI, Machine Learning, and data requirements for AI applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in automotive, manufacturing, engineering, or R&D environments.

Familiarity with engineering data such as vehicle test data, measurement data, simulation results, ECU logs, or development documentation.

Experience working with enterprise data governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK or similar approaches.

Familiarity with data cataloging and governance tools.

Understanding of cloud data platforms and modern data architectures.

Experience preparing enterprise knowledge sources for RAG applications or AI agents.

Awareness of data privacy, cybersecurity, and applicable data protection requirements.

Experience with Git, data versioning, and automated data quality checks.

Key Deliverables & Expected Outcomes

The Successful Candidate Will Contribute To The Following Deliverables

R&D Data Inventory & Classification: Establish and maintain an overview of important R&D data assets, including ownership, sensitivity, accessibility, and potential AI usage.

Data Governance Framework: Support the development of practical governance guidelines covering data ownership, classification, quality, access, and lifecycle management.

AI Data Readiness Assessment: Establish a structured approach for evaluating datasets before they are used in AI applications.

Data Quality Monitoring: Define and implement measurable data quality indicators and improvement actions.

AI Use Case Data Support: Prepare and validate data sources required for prioritized AI initiatives.

Data Analytics & Reporting: Develop dashboards and analytical reports that improve visibility into R&D data and support decision-making.

Data Documentation & Traceability: Improve metadata, data lineage, data definitions, and documentation of critical datasets.

Success Measures / KPIs

Performance May Be Evaluated Through

Percentage of prioritized R&D data assets inventoried and classified.

Percentage of critical datasets with identified owners and documented metadata.

Improvement in data quality scores for prioritized datasets.

Number of AI use cases supported with completed data readiness assessments.

Percentage of prioritized AI use cases with suitable and approved data sources.

Reduction in recurring data quality and accessibility issues.

Number of reusable, documented, AI-ready datasets delivered.

Completion of agreed data governance and improvement milestones.

Personal Competencies

Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

Ability to translate complex technical data topics into practical business actions.

Proactive and improvement-oriented mindset.

Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Attention to detail, data accuracy, and traceability.

Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

Interest in emerging AI technologies and their application in engineering and R&D.

Why Join Us?

This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the development of a modern, AI-enabled R&D organization.

You will work at the intersection of engineering, data, and Artificial Intelligence, helping establish the data foundations required for intelligent applications, automation, and next-generation R&D capabilities.

You will play an important role in transforming fragmented engineering data into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets that support innovation across the organization.

We are one of the most well respected commercial construction company in Northern Virginia, known for our commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability. This is a reputation for delivering high-quality construction projects on time and within budget. 

We have completed a wide range of commercial buildings, including office buildings, medical facilities, retail spaces, and government buildings. We already have a backlog for the next 6yrs.

Because of our growth, we are looking for a Construction Project Manager who, with at least 5yrs of recent experience within a ground up commercial construction environment & is wanting to grow within our company.

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of construction project management, from inception to completion. The Project Manager will work closely with clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams to deliver successful projects.

Project Planning and Coordination:

Project Execution:

Manage subcontractors and vendors, including negotiating contracts, monitoring performance, and ensuring timely delivery of materials and services.

Monitor project expenses and implement cost-saving measures where necessary.
Prepare and submit accurate and timely invoices and financial reports.

Risk Management:

Resolve any issues or conflicts that arise during the project lifecycle.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory and legal requirements.

Provide guidance and support to team members, ensuring their professional development and growth.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback.

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.

We need true proficiency in Procore & Sage (We use Sage 300) 
Proven track record of managing commercial construction projects from start to finish.
Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and regulations.
Excellent organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
Proficiency in project management software and tools.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
Retirement savings plan with company match.
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
A collaborative and supportive work environment.

jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Location:
Fremont, CA

Reports To:
Director Global Accounts Executive

Salary Range:
$132,000-$200,000

Position Summary

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic Commercial Program Manager
to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The Commercial Program Manager
is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Non-Discrimination Statement

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are…

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Position Overview

As a Project Manager, you will play a key role in providing world class support to our external clients and internal teams by managing the end-to-end implementation of contracted technical programs and ensuring they are delivered in a timely manner. No challenge will be too big, and no issue will go unsolved! You are responsible for tracking the status of all programs / projects as assigned by working with different stakeholders, managing customer expectations, providing status reports to management, active risk and issue management, and drive risks/issues/actions to closure. You will create and manage project plans, communicate schedules with different stakeholders and ensure successful delivery of all projects and tickets. You will work in a highly collaborative environment with a team that is geographically distributed. You will adhere to agile software development processes accepted by the organization. The candidate should have excellent analytical and interpersonal abilities and always looking to improve process and bring in efficiencies. Performs other duties as required.

Essential Responsibilities

Responsible for project management of assigned client implementations.
Partner with a cross-functional project team to deliver programs on time, on budget and according to contractual requirements.
Develop, distribute, and manage consolidated project plans, status reports, dashboards and communicate with stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Location:
Surrey, BC, Canada

Reports To:
Director Global Accounts Executive

Salary Range:
CAD $114,000-$156,000

Position Summary

We are a rapidly expanding manufacturing company focused on delivering complex, high-volume solutions for leading enterprise customers. Our success is built on operational excellence, strategic partnerships, and an unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a professional, proactive, and strategic Commercial Program Manager
to lead and manage the partnership with one of our most critical enterprise customers.

The Commercial Program Manager
is responsible for managing the full program lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer demand and internal production capabilities. This role is accountable for aligning internal operations with client requirements, ensuring timely delivery, quality performance, and seamless execution across all phases of the program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic thinker with strong program management experience and the ability to coordinate across diverse internal teams and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Proactively review and interpret customer forecasts to identify trends, anticipate demand shifts, and align supplier capacity and internal production schedules accordingly.
Translate forecast data into actionable plans by working directly with production teams to coordinate build output and ensure readiness for deployment.
Own the process for correcting purchase orders, reconciling discrepancies, and coordinating timely pricing updates between internal teams and the customer
Respond quickly to quality and field service issues, coordinating internally to drive resolutions and minimize customer impact.
Actively contribute to customer related projects and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
Ensure program delivery aligns with customer service level agreements by constantly monitoring performance metrics and taking corrective action as needed.
Take a data-driven approach to aligning inventory with forecasted demand and support planning for body of design, product phaseouts, and lifecycle transitions.
Analyze volume trends and program data to inform decision-making, highlight risks, and support continuous improvement in delivery performance.
Monitor inventory levels closely, perform flow analysis, and take corrective actions to prevent shortages or excess while maintaining alignment with customer demand.
Foster a culture of team accountability and collaborative problem-solving across departments by setting clear expectations, following up on deliverables, and driving shared program goals forward.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering or related field (MBA or PMP certification a plus).
5+ years of program or project management experience in a manufacturing or enterprise client-facing role with annualized volume exceeding $10 million.
Proven track record managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders across technical and business functions.
Strong understanding of supply chain processes, inventory management, and demand planning.
Experience with ERP and customer portal tools.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and drive results across functional boundaries.
Comfortable managing ambiguity and adapting to a dynamic, high-growth environment.
Exceptional interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-first mentality.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

Our client, the global leader in technology-enabled claims and risk management solutions,
is actively looking for a Transformation Program Manager
for an AI-enabled software delivery transformation focused on applying AI to software delivery practices. This role is 100% remote but candidates must be able to work CST!

***This is a 12 month contract with the opportunity to extend based on performance and business needs***

This initiative will use a phased pilot-team approach
to evaluate how AI can improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and create measurable cost savings. This Program Manager will work with business, technology, engineering, offshore teams, vendors, internal AI leadership, and senior stakeholders to shape and execute the AI-enabled delivery model.
